title: Documentation & Reference Guides
description: Comprehensive reference guide split into linguistic editorial standards (Leipzig glossing, canonical OE headwords, Wiktionary/IPA) and system engineering architecture (dual-write storage, automated QA test suites).
canonicalRuleDescription: All Old English adjectives default to Masculine Nominative Singular Strong citation form. Numerals 2 & 3 default to twēgen and þrīe.
architectureSpecDescription: Dual-write storage syncs localStorage (Tier 1), .tex and .json files (Tier 2), and TinaCMS working trees (Tier 3) with zero data loss.

numeralCards.title: 1 vs. 2 & 3 (Inherent Plurals)
numeralCards.description: 1 (ān) declines with a masculine nominative singular form. However, 2 (twēgen/twā) and 3 (þrīe/þrēo) are inherently plural. Their canonical citation headwords are strictly the Masculine Nominative forms: twēgen and þrīe.

numeralCards.title: 4 to 19 (Indeclinable Cardinals)
numeralCards.description: Numbers from 4 (fēower) to 19 are largely indeclinable when modifying nouns and do not have distinct gender forms. Their citation headword is simply the base cardinal stem (fīf, siex, eahta, tīen).

numeralCards.title: Decades & Hundreds (Noun Quantifiers)
numeralCards.description: Decades and hundreds like twēntig (20), syxtig (60), and hundtēontiġ (100) behave grammatically as neuter nouns that govern a dependent genitive plural (e.g. syxtig hrāna = “sixty of reindeers”). Their dictionary headwords are the base cardinal noun forms.

ingestionSteps.title: Automatic Tokenization & Compound Splitting
ingestionSteps.description: Punctuation is cleanly isolated and bound morphemes (hyphenated compound terms like ġeār-dag-um) are systematically segmented into glossable lexical units.

ingestionSteps.title: Contextual Lemmatization Engine
ingestionSteps.description: Every token is evaluated through the Old English linguistic engine, assigning canonical masculine nominative singular strong adjective lemmas, infinitive verb lemmas, nominative noun lemmas, and direct Wiktionary etymological links.

ingestionSteps.title: Dual-Write Persistence & LaTeX Export
ingestionSteps.description: Saving writes structured JSON to content/texts/<slug>.json and compilable LaTeX to references/<slug>.tex, immediately rendering the text available across the visual reader and live editor.

wiktionaryGuidelines.title: Diacritics Stripped in Page Titles
wiktionaryGuidelines.description: Vowel macrons (ā, ē, ī, ō, ū, ȳ) and palatal dots (ċ, ġ) are modern editorial additions and are omitted from page titles (e.g. secgan, hlaford).

wiktionaryGuidelines.title: Historical Letters Retained
wiktionaryGuidelines.description: Ash (æ), thorn (þ), and eth (ð) are standard Latin letters in Wiktionary titles (e.g. cweþan#Old_English).

wiktionaryGuidelines.title: Proper Noun Capitalization
wiktionaryGuidelines.description: Proper nouns and tribal names are capitalized (Ohthere, Ælfred); common vocabulary is always lowercase.

wiktionaryGuidelines.title: Anchor Standard
wiktionaryGuidelines.description: Headword links specifically target the #Old_English section anchor to jump past other languages directly to Old English.

ipaSpecifications.title: Phonemic Slashes
ipaSpecifications.description: Transcriptions use phonemic slashes /.../ for citation headwords.

ipaSpecifications.title: Triangular Length Colon
ipaSpecifications.description: Vowel length is transcribed with the standard IPA triangular length mark ː (U+02D0), not an ASCII colon.

ipaSpecifications.title: Primary Stress
ipaSpecifications.description: Polysyllabic stress is indicated with the IPA vertical stroke ˈ (U+02C8) preceding the stressed syllable (e.g. /ˈbuː.ɑn/).

ipaSpecifications.title: Uninflected Citation
ipaSpecifications.description: Pronunciations reflect the canonical lemma headword rather than contextual inflected forms.

storageTiers.title: Browser Local Storage
storageTiers.description: Every edit is automatically saved with a 300ms debounce to localStorage under unique slug keys, protecting work against accidental reloads or closing tabs.

storageTiers.title: Filesystem Dual-Write
storageTiers.description: Clicking Save to TinaCMS or pressing Ctrl+S writes updated .tex to references/ and structured JSON to content/texts/.

storageTiers.title: TinaCMS GraphQL Bridge
storageTiers.description: The updated document is dispatched to TinaCMS GraphQL repository working trees, ensuring instant editorial synchronization and visual authoring fidelity.
